title: ADUSA Distribution Claims Processing
description: Standard operating procedure for processing deductions and claims for ADUSA Distribution, Giant Company, Giant Foods, and Stop & Shop accounts.

sections.title: Purpose
sections.content: Define the process for receiving, validating, and resolving deduction claims submitted by ADUSA Distribution and affiliated banners including Giant Company, Giant Foods, and Stop & Shop.

sections.title: Scope
sections.content: Applies to all Acosta associates handling ADUSA Distribution accounts. Covers direct deductions, short payments, and promotional allowance claims.

sections.title: Definitions
sections.content:
**Deduction**: A short payment taken by the customer against an open invoice.
**Backup**: Supporting documentation provided by the customer to justify the deduction.
**Acosta**: Global Customer Invoice Team, responsible for deduction management.
**Banner**: Individual retail chain operating under the ADUSA umbrella.

sections.title: Roles & Responsibilities
sections.content:
**Acosta Associate**: Receives and logs all incoming deductions; requests backup documentation.
**Team Lead**: Reviews aged deductions over 60 days; escalates invalid claims.
**Client Manager**: Approves write-offs and settlement agreements over threshold.

sections.title: Procedure Steps
sections.content:
1. Log new deduction in the deduction management system within 2 business days of receipt.
2. Identify claim type: promotional, pricing, shortage, or damage.
3. Cross-reference against open trade funds and approved promotional calendar.
4. Request backup via email to vendor.queries@adusa.com if not automatically provided.
5. Validate backup against original purchase order and invoice.
6. Approve valid claims; dispute invalid claims with written rationale.
7. Escalate unresolved disputes older than 45 days to Team Lead.
8. Document resolution and close deduction record.

sections.title: References
sections.content: ADUSA Vendor Guide v2.1 · Acosta Deduction Policy Manual · Acosta Trade Funds Policy
